schema.description:
A period of time that constrains which records are combined into a report of Emission Statements.

Must specify a valid from and valid to date time attribute that can be used to infer the optional year,
month, quarter, and/or other periodic attributes.
schema.title: Emission Report Period

valid_to_datetime.description: The date and optional time to which the emission reporting period is valid, in ISO 8601 date time standardized format.

emission_report_period_id.description: The Primary Key assigned to the Emission Report Period.

valid_from_datetime.description: The date and optional time from which the emission reporting period is valid, in ISO 8601 date time standardized format.

month.description: The month of the Emission Report Period defined as an integer.

end_datetime.description: DEPRECATED, This can be replace by Valid To.

year.description: The year assigned to the Emission Report Period.

name.description: The name assigned to the Emission Report Period.

description.description: Long description of the Emission Report Period.

begin_datetime.description: DEPRECATED, This can be replace by Valid From.

frequency.description: The frequency of the Emission Report Period; e.g., annually, quarterly, or monthly.

quarter.description: The quarter used by the Emission Report Period.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.
